"Hello! 👋 I’m a big fan of your soccer game, and I have an idea I’d love to share with your development team. I want to see a more realistic and immersive football experience, with better gameplay, smarter AI, realistic player movements, improved career mode, transfers, stadium atmosphere, and more freedom for players to build their own teams.

I believe these features could make the game even more enjoyable and keep players coming back. I would love to know if your team is open to community suggestions and new ideas.

Thank you for your time! ⚽

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Touchline

A complete, browser-playable football game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Open `index.html` directly or serve this directory with any static web server.

- Play 90-second friendly matches against adaptive opponents.
- Move with **WASD / arrow keys**, **Shift** to sprint, **Space** to pass or shoot, and **Q** to switch player.
- On touch screens, use the on-screen direction pad and action button (or tap and drag on the pitch).
- Track your season, earn coins from matches, and sign free agents. Better signings automatically enter your starting six; displaced players move to the bench.
- Career progress, results, squad, and wallet are saved in your browser.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable football game inspired by the user’s request for more immersive gameplay, smarter AI, career progression, transfers, stadium atmosphere, and team building.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained browser game, “Touchline,” using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Assumed a single-player, top-down 6-a-side friendly with keyboard and touch controls; career, transfers, and results save in browser local storage.

## Work State

### Completed
- Built the club hub, match screen, career standings/objectives, squad roster, transfer market, match HUD, and responsive touch controls.
- Implemented movement, passing/shooting, opponent AI, goals, match results/rewards, player switching, pause/full-time overlays, and local saves.
- Added transfer signings that enter the starting six and send the displaced player to the bench.
- Documented the game and controls in `README.md`.
- Validated gameplay and transfer signing in headless Chromium; inspected desktop and mobile screenshots. Mobile controls and responsive squad layout rendered successfully.

### Active
- Finish a small gameplay polish pass and revalidate after the latest opponent-AI direction fix.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because its bundled Chromium was missing; direct headless Chromium at `/usr/bin/chromium` worked instead.

## Next Move
1. Make ball movement frame-rate independent (`ball.x/y += ball.vx/vy * dt * 60`).
2. Optionally add an inline favicon to avoid the observed `/favicon.ico` 404.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and repeat a quick browser smoke test, including match controls and transfers.
4. Review `git status`; changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `game.js`: Match simulation, AI, controls, career, transfers, and local persistence.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.
- `README.md`: Game overview and controls.

## Important Context
- The latest change corrected opponent ball carriers to attack toward the left goal; rerun validation after it.
- Earlier browser smoke tests showed no page errors, but the browser logged a missing favicon request.

+## Touchline
+
+A complete, browser-playable football game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Open `index.html` directly or serve this directory with any static web server.
+
+- Play 90-second friendly matches against adaptive opponents.
+- Move with **WASD / arrow keys**, **Shift** to sprint, **Space** to pass or shoot, and **Q** to switch player.
+- On touch screens, use the on-screen direction pad and action button (or tap and drag on the pitch).
+- Track your season, earn coins from matches, and sign free agents. Better signings automatically enter your starting six; displaced players move to the bench.
+- Career progress, results, squad, and wallet are saved in your browser.
